'''July 2000 Helsinki tournament''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Safe Haven, Helsinki, Finland on 16 July 2000. [[Lari Laine]] won it. It is known from Christoffer Niska's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1009">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-the-sauna-helsinki-finland-16-7-2000d1009/ the-sauna-helsinki-finland-16-7-2000], DeckTech (Christoffer "Thedit" Niska, 16 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-16-the-sauna-helsinki-finland-16-7-2000d1009/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 16 July 2000
* '''Site:''' Safe Haven, Helsinki, Finland
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Endor]]
* '''Players:''' 15
* '''Winner:''' [[Lari Laine]]
